dev_notes: assets/RESTYLE.md, filled with the product name, the style section, the entry count and the area list.

history.name: Moving an existing ledger to a new tone
history.description: The command ledger style rewrite prints a brief for rewriting a ledger that is already written into the tone the project has moved to. The agent works one area at a time and replaces the words in place, so nothing lands on the release and no entry is marked as changed.

The command ledger style rewrite prints a brief for rewriting the entries still in an earlier tone, one area at a time. Each finished area is marked done, so an interrupted rewrite carries on from the areas left.

events.what: A rewrite into a new tone covers only the entries still in the old one, and carries on from the areas left when a rewrite stops partway.
events.why: The tone each entry was written in is recorded rather than guessed from its text, so the same entries are never rewritten into the tone they already have.
